content: Wi-Fi and Bluetooth need the radio firmware from the Innioasis Y2 firmware package.
Copy (do not move) the file system.img from that package into this folder (about
520 MB). The player checks it, keeps the five small radio files and deletes the copy.
A larger system.img (about 860 MB) is an unpacked copy: if there is not enough space
here, put it into a folder named Firmware on the SD card instead.
